about_short_description.short_description: Openlayer is an analysis platform that "opens up" machine learning models by detecting and eliminating failure patterns and biases.

product.name: LLM Observability
product.description: Provides visibility into large language model pipelines by tracing system behavior, monitoring cost and latency, and detecting failures before impacting users.

product.name: LLM Evaluation
product.description: Enables rigorous testing of generative AI and LLMs by evaluating prompts, tracing responses, and validating outputs with customizable tests.

product.name: ML Observability
product.description: Continuously monitors machine learning systems to track performance, detect drift, and identify live issues with automated observability.

product.name: ML Evaluation
product.description: Offers comprehensive testing of machine learning models with over 100 customizable tests, version comparisons, and automated CI/CD validation to catch regressions.

product.name: Data Quality Monitoring
product.description: Automates checks on data pipelines to detect schema changes, drift, and anomalies, preventing bad data from affecting models.

product.name: AI Compliance & Governance
product.description: Integrates compliance and governance tools into AI workflows to meet global standards and maintain audit readiness with fairness and traceability features.
